<?php
/*
 * Avacy demo site for the Google CMP Partner Program.
 * - The front end is seen by a logged-out visitor: Playground logs the admin in, and Site Kit does
 *   not print the Google tag for logged-in admins. wp-admin stays logged in.
 * - No calls to api.wordpress.org: the network panel shows only the site, Avacy and Google.
 * - Standard banner layout: the site runs in Playground's iframe, which the banner would detect.
 *   The flag touches layout and title only, not consent or the Google signals.
 */
add_filter('determine_current_user', function ($uid) {
    $uri = $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '';
    if (preg_match('#/(wp-admin|wp-login\.php|wp-json|index\.php\?rest_route)#', $uri) || (defined('DOING_AJAX') && DOING_AJAX)) {
        return $uid;
    }
    return false;
}, 99999);

add_filter('pre_http_request', function ($pre, $args, $url) {
    if (strpos($url, '://api.wordpress.org/') !== false) {
        return new WP_Error('avacy_demo_offline', 'Update checks are off on this demo site.');
    }
    return $pre;
}, 10, 3);
add_filter('automatic_updater_disabled', '__return_true');

add_action('wp_enqueue_scripts', function () {
    wp_add_inline_script('avacy-cmp-web', 'window.__AVACY_FORCE_STANDARD_LAYOUT__ = true;', 'before');
}, 20);
